title: helm(private): validate values schema + init hooks for upgrade/rollback stability
author: Priya Shah
description: Add explicit values.schema.json validation for the redwood-private Helm chart, introduce pre-upgrade init hook to migrate legacy config and a post-rollback cleanup hook to ensure KV cache/state is consistent after failed upgrades. Motivation: customers hit edge-case failures when upgrading private clusters with older values shapes (missing network.vpcId, changed storage topology). This PR adds a JSON Schema for values.yaml, plugs schema validation into helm chart-testing and CI, and adds two lifecycle hooks: a pre-upgrade Job that validates cluster invariants and migrates legacy fields (with a dry-run mode) and a post-rollback Job that removes partially-applied resources and marks the release for manual inspection. Also updates templating to be tolerant across Helm 3.x patch versions, adds unit tests for template rendering, and expands chart-testing matrix to include kube 1.23/1.24/1.25. The description below covers changes, commits, tests, and review notes.

Priya Shah: Narrowed permissions to specific verbs on Secrets, ConfigMaps and CustomResources used by the installer.
Samir Gupta: CI failed lint on first run due to trailing whitespace in values.schema.json and a missing metadata.version bump; reran and green.
Marina Torres: Recommend adding a flag to skip migration for emergency hotfixes; added --skip-migration to the chart via values.skipMigration boolean.
Evan Liu: Approving once CI is green and tests pass; left a note about follow-up telemetry to track migrations.
